items.title: Amazon's AWS business has taken on a life of its own: Earnings call takeaways
items.summary: Amazon's (AMZN) AWS business saw 37% revenue growth this most recent quarter. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chats with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about the results and future growth.

items.title: Silicon Valley loves young founders. Until it doesn’t.

items.title: Amazon and Apple Deliver the Drama to Close a Turbulent Month
items.summary: A surge in  Amazon  stock Friday gave the Nasdaq enough momentum to obscure  Apple  slump.  Beneath the surface of the Nasdaq composite’s 1% gain was a tug of war between Apple stock, which fell 7.4%, and Amazon’s which surged 15%.  The post-earnings slide, Apple’s largest since 2014, followed company forecasts for its September quarter that fell short of Wall Street’s expectations.

items.title: Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Micron, Roblox, Reddit, SK Hynix, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  It shaped up to be a positive end to a bad month for stocks. The tech rebound continued, even as a big decline from Apple weighed on the major indexes.  Amazon gained 15% after second-quarter earnings and revenue comfortably beat expectations.

items.title: Winners and Losers in Tech Stocks This Week
items.summary: Over the past two days, four of the trillion-dollar tech giants have reported earnings. Each day, there's been one clear winner and one clear loser. Today, Amazon stock was the winner while Apple shares fell.
